breaking.change: Removed -og-reduced-motion (fade, none, keep). An element's transitions under the player's reduced motion now follow standard CSS: a transition written under @media (prefers-reduced-motion) plays as written; any other keeps the engine's fallback (movement jumps, opacity and colour fade quickly).
breaking.fix: For none, write @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .x { transition: none; } }. For keep, repeat the element's transition inside that block. Drop fade: it is the fallback for every transition not written for reduced motion.
